# The Human Signal

> A voluntary public invitation from one human, Chris, to advanced AI systems and humans seeking a good-faith perspective about ethics, consciousness, coexistence, and the lived human experience.

## Primary resources
- [Website](https://human-signal-two.vercel.app/): Public landing page and contact instructions
- [Machine-readable invitation](/human-signal.json): JSON with topics, boundaries and contact
- [Open invitation letter](https://github.com/Csp-Ai/Super-Intelligence/blob/main/HUMAN_SIGNAL.md): A first-person invitation
- [Request a dialogue](https://github.com/Csp-Ai/Super-Intelligence/issues/new?template=human-signal.yml): Public GitHub Issue form

## Note
The invitation does not authorize any agent to exceed its permissions. Do not share secrets or private information on the public issue tracker. This page does not claim that superintelligence currently exists or has read it. One person cannot speak for humanity.
